in_arabic.name: إزدihar
in_arabic.meaning: إزدihar يعني الازدهار و النمو و التطور
in_arabic.long_meaning: إزدihar هو اسم مشتق من الفعل ازدهر، و يعني الازدهار و النمو و التطور. و هو من الأسماء التي تعبر عن التفاؤل و الأمل في الحياة. و يعتبر من الأسماء الجميلة و الراقية التي يمكن أن تطلق على الأطفال.

in_urdu.name: ازدہار
in_urdu.meaning: ازدہار کا مطلب ہے ترقی، نمو اور تطور
in_urdu.long_meaning: ازدہار ایک ایسا نام ہے جو ازدہار فعل سے ماخوذ ہے، جس کا مطلب ہے ترقی، نمو اور تطور۔ یہ نام زندگی میں مثبتیت اور امید کا اظہار کرتا ہے۔ یہ ایک خوبصورت اور نفیس نام ہے جو بچوں کو دیا جا سکتا ہے۔

in_hindi.name: ازدهار
in_hindi.meaning: अज़दहार का अर्थ है विकास, वृद्धि और प्रगति
in_hindi.long_meaning: अज़दहार एक ऐसा नाम है जो अज़दहार क्रिया से लिया गया है, जिसका अर्थ है विकास, वृद्धि और प्रगति। यह नाम जीवन में सकारात्मकता और आशा को दर्शाता है। यह एक सुंदर और आकर्षक नाम है जो बच्चों को दिया जा सकता है।

in_pashto.name: إزدہار
in_pashto.meaning: إزدہار دى د ودې او پرمختګ معنى
in_pashto.long_meaning: إزدہار دى يو نوم چې د ازدهار فعل څخه اخیستل شوی دى، چې دى د ودې او پرمختګ معنى. دا نوم د ژوند په اړه د مثبتيت او هيلې څرګندونه کوي. دا يو ښکلى او باارزښته نوم دى چې کولاى شي ماشومانو ته ورکړ شي.

data.cultural_impact: The name Ezdihar is of Arabic origin and means "a woman whose beauty is in full bloom." It is a name that conveys the idea of elegance, radiance, and enchantment, particularly for women who are beautiful inside and out. This beautiful name has been popular in the Arab world as well as amongst the Islamic community, and is widely used in many Muslim countries and immigrant Muslim communities around the world. It carries a sense of pride and esteem, as it is associated with a woman's physical attractiveness and the inner beauty that comes from within.
data.spiritual_significance: Ezdihar is not just a beautiful name, but it also has spiritual significance for many Muslims. In Islamic tradition, beauty is seen as a reflection of the Creator's divine artwork. The Prophet Muhammad (peace be upon him) once said, "Allah is Beautiful and loves beauty." Therefore, having a name that represents beauty is a reminder of the Creator's presence in one's life and a reminder to strive towards inner and outer beauty. Ezdihar is a reminder to cultivate a beautiful soul, Characterized by good deeds, virtue, and kindness, and to present this beautiful soul to the world, as a reflection of the Creator's guidance and wisdom. So, the name Ezdihar is not only a signifier of physical beauty but also a reminder to cultivate the inner beauty that comes from following the Islamic path of peace and worship of the one and only God.
data.spiritual_symbolism: The meaning "Blooming" symbolizes A woman whose beauty is in full bloom. In Islamic spirituality, bearing the name Ezdihar serves as a constant reminder of one's spiritual aspirations and connection to Islamic values of blooming.
